title: Jayashan Manodya
organisations: Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology
executive_summary: Jayashan Manodya is an IT undergraduate specializing in Artificial Intelligence, focused on developing intelligent technologies to solve real-world problems. He has experience in various AI projects, including personalized nutrition, conversational shopping, document question answering, and more, utilizing modern software engineering practices.

section_summaries.summary: Jayashan Manodya is an IT undergraduate with a specialization in Artificial Intelligence, aiming to become an AI Engineer. He is engaged in projects related to Generative AI, machine learning, and full-stack development.
Currently pursuing a BSc (Hons) in IT specializing in Artificial Intelligence at the Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology with a GPA of 3.93/4.0.

Jayashan has developed multiple AI-powered systems, including NutriLens AI for personalized nutrition, KIKO as a shopping assistant, and IKMS for document question answering, showcasing his skills in various technologies.
He is currently a part-time Creative Designer at Glanz Digital, contributing to digital marketing and branding efforts.
Jayashan possesses a strong skill set in programming languages, frameworks, AI/ML tools, databases, and deployment technologies.
He has completed several certifications in AI, programming, web development, and digital marketing.
Jayashan has been recognized on the Dean's List and has achieved notable rankings in competitions.

important_facts: GPA: 3.93/4.0 in most recent semester at Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology.
Dean’s List Recipient for achieving a semester GPA above 3.7.
